self_attack.question: Could this baseline look complete while the learner still lacks the ability it is meant to train?
self_attack.answer: Yes. Asset/topic coverage and overlap accounting prove material readiness only. Case discrimination, cross-system switching, timed transfer and precision still require actual learner performance. Historical materials never manufacture learner U.
fail_closed_conditions: Raw SRT provenance without readable bytes does not count as sentence-level source-fidelity closure.
Teacher mnemonics or treatment/legal/current-year statements that conflict with Current canonical Source are not promoted.
Annotated four-mock pages cannot be used as clean unseen score evidence.
A 27-cycle material change is UNKNOWN until the 27 source itself is present and version-verified.
